answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond in a vault and earn access to valuable tasks only after completing work that independent peers verify. A forge can mint thousands of fake identities, but it cannot make them pass verification for free: every identity must lock capital, while dishonest work risks a measurable slash. The attacker therefore pays per Sybil and must keep funds tied up; basalt-hard collateral rules make scaling the attack costly, not merely a matter of creating more accounts.
